name: Baseline: a complete fictional journey meets every candidate condition for both products
Incomplete breadth: the core stage complete but breadth stopped with tier 2 unanswered fails the Essential (the defect MK reproduced) and the Comprehensive
detail: core complete, breadth incomplete, tier 2 and 3 answered 1 of 62; Essential fails EF-2,EF-4,EF-5; Comprehensive fails EF-2,EF-4,EF-5,CF-2,CF-3,CG-2

name: Declined function package: every confirmation answered but one function declining its whole package fails the Comprehensive (the defect MK reproduced); the Essential, which rests on confirmations, still meets and discloses it
detail: confirmations answered 108 of 108; Procurement declined 11 of 11 (11 of them practices, listed as outstanding); Essential meets; Comprehensive fails CB-2,CP-1

name: Missing blueprint inputs: a function answering "I don't know" to every diagnostic question leaves the scenarios it serves without blueprint inputs, so the Comprehensive fails
detail: HR and payroll not known 11 of 15; open scenarios without a diagnostic answer 3; Essential meets; Comprehensive fails CB-2

name: Incomplete governance information: the risk function declining its package fails the governance analysis (CG-3); not knowing who has oversight holds the core stage open and fails both products
detail: risk package declined: Essential meets; Comprehensive fails CG-3,CP-1. Oversight unknown: core incomplete; Essential fails EF-1,EF-2,EA-1; Comprehensive fails EF-1,EF-2,EA-1,CG-1,CG-2,CG-3,CP-1; the report names "The oversight body (not identified in the answers)"

name: Outstanding confirmations: a quarter of tier 1 confirmations not known by the respondent and declined by the function fails both products; none is counted as answered
detail: tier 1 answered 34 of 45; outstanding on confirmations 11; Essential fails EF-3; Comprehensive fails EF-3,CF-1,CF-2,CB-3,CG-2,CG-3,CP-1

name: Optional diagnostics are not required: only questions put to the organisation count, so the small firm meets both products although most of the method's diagnostic questions were never asked
detail: diagnostic questions asked 22 of 186 applicable supporting practices; Essential meets; Comprehensive meets

name: Information and method conditions are kept apart: a control without library content fails a method condition, never an information condition
detail: Essential failing EA-2 (information met true); Comprehensive failing CB-3,CP-3,EA-2

name: Candidate only: the evaluator imports nothing from orders, entitlements, payments, fulfilment or products, and every result says the rules are not approved
